notCovered.question: I recorded a voice clip using the audio API, but how do I get the local file path so I can play it back in an audio player?
notCovered.answer:
To save a recording and access the local file system, you need to use `expo-file-system` (Module 8, Lesson: Microphone & Audio in Expo   Permissions, Recording & Playback, at 05:48 – 06:28). Please note that to have complete permission to access the local file system, you must create an Android or iOS build (Module 8, Lesson: Microphone & Audio in Expo   Permissions, Recording & Playback, at 05:48 – 06:28). 

Once you have the file, you can use `mediaLibrary.saveToLibraryAsync` by passing the file, which will contain the URI (Module 16, Lesson: Chapter 4 Implementing Imagedetailmodal Components, at 21:33 – 22:14).
